defs.def: a person who is trying to be elected or is applying for a job （竞选或求职的）候选人，申请人

ex.s: Your application will be accessed by UNESCO managers and will stay in our database for six months．We do not respond to every candidate．If selected，you will be contacted by a manager．If you do not receive any update within six months，it means that your application has not been successful．
ex.t: 你的申请将由联合国教科文组织的经理审阅，并在我们的数据库中保留六个月。我们不会回复每一位候选人。如果被选中，会有经理与你联系。如果六个月内未收到任何更新，则意味着你的申请未获成功。

ex.s: When hiring committees see this, they see candidate who is capable of working in a variety of environments.
ex.t: 当雇用委员会看到这一点时，他们就会看到能够在各种环境中工作的候选人。

ex.s: Submit a three-minute video introducing yourself and saying why you would be an ideal space candidate.
ex.t: 提交一段三分钟视频，介绍你自己，并说明为何你会是理想的太空人选。

ex.s: Let’s move on to the next candidate.
ex.t: 我们接着看下一位候选人。

ex.s: REFLECTING candidate commitment cruel damp motive resolution wage One hundred years ago, exploring the Antarctic was a dangerous business.
ex.t: 反思　候选人　投入　残酷的　潮湿的　动机　决心　工资　一百年前，探索南极是件危险的事。

defs.def: a person taking an exam 投考者；应试者；参加考试的人

ex.s: Goodideato usean 4 to explain why you're the right candidate.
ex.t: 好主意：用4____来说明为什么你是合适的人选。

defs.def: a person or group that is considered suitable for sth or that is likely to get sth or to be sth 被认定适合者；被认定有某种结局者

ex.s: Brainstorm and make a list of possible candidates that you would like to conduct research on.
ex.t: 头脑风暴，列出你想研究的几位可能人选。

ex.s: The adorable female calf is the second black rhino born this year at the reserve, but it is too early to tell if the calves will make good candidates to be returned to protected areas of the wild.
ex.t: 这只可爱的雌性幼崽是今年该保护区出生的第二头黑犀牛，但现在判断这些幼崽是否适合被放归野外保护区还为时过早。
